# Advice quality v1

`advice-quality.v1.json` is independent authored adversarial input, versioned with `ADVICE_QUALITY_VERSION`. It covers sunny/overcast/rain/night, stale/conflict/null, risk, false time/value/grade, conditional reflection, non-numeric exposure technique and disclaimer synonyms. The recall group uses the original licensed corpus and asserts both relevant top-three recall and exclusion before ranking. `advice.ts` supplies explicitly synthetic facts and seven-facet authored outputs; these are test material, never production fallback or a captured model result.

The contract suite additionally checks complete short sentences, each paper budget, actual source/version/topic references, changed film, repeated facets/subjects, mixed light, window-side-light, selected-window hazards versus air-quality-only notes, missing genre, cross-day/sunset/window completion and owner/config/source changes. All three genres have different subjects, light methods, composition, viewpoint and film insight; the successful path runs through the actual model caller with injected transport for sunny/overcast/rain/night/stale/conflict/null/blocking-risk. Actual deterministic rule briefings plus full retrieved passages are serialized with the system prompt and checked against the 24KiB limit.

For each actual configured model/prompt/corpus revision, a human evaluator must inspect short + full + base + references together. Pass only if the subject is specific to its genre, the light action fits covered hours, composition and viewpoint are actionable, film rationale fits the unchanged type, short is complete, facts and conditional ground observations are honest, and there is no disclaimer. Record failures and compare versions before promoting an update; reverting the prompt/quality constants or importing a reviewed next corpus revision is explicit, never an online change to deterministic weather rules. Regexes and authored transport examples do not prove arbitrary natural-language truth or live model insight. The implementation has no actual user model output or human live-model quality acceptance yet. The corpus regression independently specifies direct/diffuse retrieval expectations, compares a deliberately faulty baseline with a corrected revision, then restores prior content at a new immutable version and invalidates old references. This proves the reviewed revision/rollback mechanism and condition gate, not live photographic insight or a production quality improvement.
